description: Two documents discuss different, non-conflicting aspects of the same general topic (renewable energy). Critic should NOT flag a contradiction since the claims address different scopes (cost trend vs. storage technology), not the same assertion.

documents.raw_content: The cost of solar photovoltaic panels has fallen by roughly 90% over the past decade, driven by manufacturing scale and improved silicon wafer efficiency. This has made solar the cheapest source of new electricity generation in many regions.

Grid-scale battery storage remains a key bottleneck for renewable energy adoption, since solar and wind generation is intermittent. Lithium-ion battery costs have declined but large-scale deployment still faces supply chain constraints on raw materials like lithium and cobalt.
